description: Conformance cases for the v1 contract. Each `data` is one event delivered on its own to a replica with this registry; `outcome` is what it must report. Cases with a `rule` break a rule from schema/v1/README.md.

cases.name: activity/put
cases.description: An activity with the muscles it works, how it's loaded, the kit it needs and how it trains.

cases.name: activity/yours
cases.description: Your own activities are `x.` and a slug.

cases.name: activity/dotted-id
cases.description: Only the `x.` prefix has a dot.

cases.name: location/put
cases.description: A place to train, named by a slug, with what you have there.

cases.name: location/dashed-id
cases.description: Ids are lowercase letters, digits and underscores only.

cases.name: plan/put
cases.description: A plan over a span of days.

cases.name: planned_session/put
cases.description: An agent plans a session in a plan; it owns its blocks and planned efforts.

cases.name: session/put-in-progress
cases.description: A session started on the phone, with its offset and zone, carrying out a planned session.

cases.name: effort/put
cases.description: A set logged in pounds, part of a session and answering a planned effort.

cases.name: effort/edit
cases.description: An edit names the version it was made against.

cases.name: effort/skipped
cases.description: A planned set marked skipped.

cases.name: effort/retract
cases.description: Removing a set is a write like any edit.

cases.name: effort/undo
cases.description: Undo writes the previous content back, marked with the event it takes back.

cases.name: effort/resolve
cases.description: Resolving a conflict names every head it saw.

cases.name: session/put-completed
cases.description: The finished session, with totals, written with its last set in one batch.

cases.name: observation/body-mass
cases.description: A weight typed on the phone.

cases.name: observation/sleep-stage
cases.description: A stretch of sleep in one stage.

cases.name: observation/range
cases.description: A range needs no invented value, as under `metrics`.

cases.name: observation/no-measure
cases.description: An observation holds a value, a range or both.

cases.name: observation/custom-code
cases.description: Your own `x.` code.

cases.name: observation/unknown-code
cases.description: A code this registry doesn't list is kept as written.

cases.name: effort/unknown-unit
cases.description: A unit the code's entry doesn't list is kept and not converted.

cases.name: source_record/put
cases.description: A WHOOP recovery revision, its record and event ids derived from what it holds.

cases.name: source_record/retract
cases.description: WHOOP deleted the record; the retract names the revision it deletes.

cases.name: source_record/erase
cases.description: You erase a source's record; erase is yours, not the connector's.

cases.name: effort/redacted
cases.description: An event of an erased record, blanked and pointing at the erase.

cases.name: overlay/correct
cases.description: Your correction to a WHOOP workout's values.

cases.name: overlay/exclude
cases.description: Hide a source's record from every read.

payload.notes: The strap was on someone else.

cases.name: overlay/same-as
cases.description: This WHOOP workout is the session you logged.

cases.name: overlay/rearrange
cases.description: Your exercise order and a swap on an agent's planned session.

cases.name: setting/source-priority
cases.description: WHOOP wins by default; the scale wins for weight.

cases.name: setting/home-zone
cases.description: The zone for anything without an offset.

cases.name: setting/equipment
cases.description: Null means every piece of equipment.

cases.name: setting/current-location
cases.description: Where the next session starts.

cases.name: unknown/kind
cases.description: A kind from a newer byobot is kept and relayed, not read.

cases.name: unknown/kind-version
cases.description: A newer version of a known kind is kept, even with fields this version lacks.

cases.name: unknown/setting
cases.description: A setting this replica doesn't know.

cases.name: later/put
cases.description: An event of a later schema_version, with envelope fields this one lacks, is kept and relayed as received, never applied.

cases.name: later/new-op
cases.description: A later schema_version may add ops; the event is kept like any other it can't read.

cases.name: later/no-hlc
cases.description: A later event is kept only if the fields every version orders and links by still parse.

cases.name: later/bad-prev
cases.description: A later event's prev still names events by id.

cases.name: envelope/missing-prev
cases.description: Every write says what it saw, even when that is nothing.

cases.name: envelope/unknown-op
cases.description: The ops are closed; undo is a command, not an op.

cases.name: envelope/put-without-kind-version
cases.description: A put says which version of its kind it carries.

cases.name: envelope/retract-with-kind-version
cases.description: Only a put carries a kind version.

cases.name: envelope/bad-hlc
cases.description: The clock reading is fixed width so it compares as text.

cases.name: envelope/extra-field
cases.description: The envelope is closed.

cases.name: envelope/model-on-human
cases.description: Only an agent has a model.

cases.name: envelope/plan-slug-id
cases.description: Authored records other than activities, locations and settings have UUIDs.

cases.name: envelope/activity-uppercase-id
cases.description: Activities are named by lowercase slugs.

cases.name: payload/record-id-in-payload
cases.description: The record id is in the envelope only.

cases.name: effort/no-time
cases.description: An effort says when it happened.

cases.name: effort/no-offset
cases.description: Times keep the writer's offset.

cases.name: effort/no-modality
cases.description: An effort says how its values were obtained.

cases.name: effort/answers-without-part
cases.description: An effort answers a planned effort, named as a part of its planned session.

cases.name: effort/part-of-plan
cases.description: An effort belongs to a session.

cases.name: session/inline-efforts
cases.description: Efforts are their own records, never inline in a session.

cases.name: session/skipped
cases.description: A session that happened is in progress or completed; skipping is for planned sessions.

cases.name: activity/with-time
cases.description: A definition carries no time or other header.

cases.name: observation/with-status
cases.description: An observation has no status.

cases.name: observation/bad-zone
cases.description: Zones are IANA names.

cases.name: observation/estimate
cases.description: An estimate from a photo: a value with the bounds it likely lies within, and a reference to the photo.

cases.name: effort/estimated-load
cases.description: A metric may be an estimate too.

cases.name: effort/pct-of-1rm
cases.description: A share of one-rep max is its own code, in percent.

cases.name: rule/code-value-unit-on-pct-of-1rm
cases.description: A share of one-rep max is a plain number: 75 means 75%.

cases.name: rule/estimate-outside-bounds
cases.description: An estimate's value lies within its bounds.

cases.name: measure/text-estimate
cases.description: Only a number has bounds.

cases.name: header/attachment-without-size
cases.description: An attachment says its media type and size.

cases.name: source_record/by-human
cases.description: Only a connector writes a source's records.

cases.name: source_record/connector-writes-effort
cases.description: A connector writes nothing but source records.

cases.name: source_record/put-with-prev
cases.description: Source revisions never conflict, so a put names no prev.

cases.name: source_record/with-header
cases.description: Everything read from a source's record is computed from raw.

cases.name: source_record/retract-with-reason
cases.description: A source's retract carries nothing, so two devices write the same event.

cases.name: erase/with-payload
cases.description: An erase carries nothing that could hold what it destroys.

cases.name: redacted/with-payload
cases.description: A blanked event keeps nothing of its payload.

cases.name: overlay/correct-a-session
cases.description: Your own records are edited, not overlaid.

cases.name: overlay/same-as-without-with
cases.description: `same_as` names the other record.

cases.name: setting/bad-home-zone
cases.description: A known setting's value has its schema.

cases.name: rule/time-order
cases.description: An interval ends after it starts, compared as instants.

cases.name: rule/date-order
cases.description: A plan ends after it starts.

cases.name: rule/range-order
cases.description: A range's min is at most its max.

cases.name: rule/code-value-integer
cases.description: Reps are whole.

cases.name: rule/code-value-bounds
cases.description: Heart rate is at most 300 per minute.

cases.name: rule/code-value-converted-bounds
cases.description: Bounds apply after converting: 2000 lb is over 700 kg.

cases.name: rule/code-value-missing-unit
cases.description: A quantity carries its unit.

cases.name: rule/code-value-unit-on-number
cases.description: RPE has no unit.

cases.name: rule/code-value-pattern
cases.description: Tempo is four digits or x.

cases.name: rule/part-ids
cases.description: Part ids are unique within a planned session.

cases.name: rule/self-reference
cases.description: An event can't have seen itself.

cases.name: rule/derived-id-source-record
cases.description: A source record's id comes from its source, type and source id.

cases.name: rule/derived-id-overlay
cases.description: There is one overlay per effect and target.
